title: 第7章 贵客盈门第8章 别致的贺礼
slug: 青铜古舟第802章你惹上事了
content_zh:
“旺！”
一声稚嫩却精神的犬吠，打破了午后的宁静。
“娘！”
陈静放下书，欢快地跑向母亲。
“稳重点儿，莫要毛毛躁躁，给少爷丢人。”
刘月慈爱地摸了摸女儿的头，这才赶忙向沈算行礼：“少爷，午饭已备好，请您移步用膳。”
“呵呵，被刘婶一提醒，我倒真觉得饿了。
走，吃饭去。”
沈算放下书，伸了个懒腰，笑着说道。
厨娘掌管着一府饮食，无异于主家性命的第一道防线。
其中的利害，懂得都懂。
时光荏苒，半月转瞬即过。
五月的天气已带上一丝燥热。
黄道吉日，宜开张！
天刚蒙蒙亮，身体明显好转、面色红润的沈算，便与钟宇一同立于披红挂彩、焕然一新的百修楼门前，准备迎宾。
他们初来乍到，根基尚浅，相识之人不多，但该有的礼数，一丝也不能马虎。
为此，钟宇领着钟财，早已将拜帖送遍了整条南街的商户，衙门口自然也未曾遗漏。
来不来是客人的心意，礼数不周便是主家的过失。
“钟叔，您说今日能来多少宾客？”
沈算望着尚显冷清的街道，随口问道。

“难说。”
钟宇微微摇头，“咱们根基尚浅，相熟的不过周掌柜，外加几面之缘的几位掌柜，还有少爷您结识的陈大壮兄弟。”
“也是”
沈算点头，勿眼睛一亮：“钟叔，周伯来了！”
他俊朗的脸上扬起真诚的笑容，快步迎向正慢悠悠踱步而来的周涛。
周涛见状，急忙抬手制止：“贤侄止步！
大喜之日，主家不宜离门迎客，站定就好！”
“哦？”
沈算脚步一顿，疑惑地看向钟宇问：“有这说法？”
钟宇反应极快，立刻点头：“确有此讲究！
是属下疏忽了，多亏周掌柜提醒。”
他心中暗道，管他有没有，顺着周掌柜的话说准没错。
“呵呵，这是我们老家的习俗。”
周涛抚须，冲沈算露出一个促狭的笑容。
content_en:
"Wang!"
A childish but energetic bark broke the afternoon tranquility.
"Mother!"
Chen Jing put down her book and ran to her mother happily.
"Be careful, don't be irritable and embarrass the young master."
Liu Yue touched her daughter's head lovingly, and then hurriedly saluted Shen Suan: "Master, lunch is ready. Please come and eat."
"Haha, I felt really hungry when Aunt Liu reminded me.
Let's go and eat. "
Shen Suan put down the book, stretched and said with a smile.
The cook is in charge of the food of the house, which is tantamount to the first line of defense for the life of the family.
Everyone understands the pros and cons.
Time flies, half a month passes in a blink of an eye.
The weather in May has been a bit hot.
It’s an auspicious day to open your business!
At dawn, Shen Suan, who was obviously improving and had a rosy complexion, stood together with Zhong Yu in front of the newly renovated Baixiu Building, ready to welcome guests.
They had just arrived, so their foundation was still shallow and they didn’t know many people, but they couldn’t be careless about the etiquette they should have.
For this reason, Zhong Yu and Zhong Cai had already sent greeting cards to all the merchants on South Street, including the Yamen Gate.
Whether they come or not is the guest's choice, and lack of etiquette is the host's fault.
"Uncle Zhong, how many guests do you think can come today?"
Shen Suan looked at the deserted street and asked casually.
"Hard to say."
Zhong Yu shook his head slightly, "We are still very familiar with each other. The only people we know well are shopkeeper Zhou, plus a few shopkeepers we have met a few times, and brother Chen Dazhuang, whom you have met, young master."
"too"
Shen Suan nodded without blinking: "Uncle Zhong, Uncle Zhou is here!"
A sincere smile appeared on his handsome face, and he quickly walked towards Zhou Tao, who was walking slowly.
Seeing this, Zhou Tao hurriedly raised his hand to stop: "My dear nephew, stop it!
On the big day, it is not appropriate for the host to leave the door to welcome guests, just stand still! "
"Oh?"
Shen Suan paused, looked at Zhong Yu doubtfully and asked, "Is there such a statement?"
Zhong Yu reacted very quickly and nodded immediately: "This is indeed important!
It was my subordinate who was negligent, thanks to Shopkeeper Zhou for reminding me. "
He thought to himself, whether he had it or not, he was right to follow what Shopkeeper Zhou said.
"Haha, this is the custom in our hometown."
Zhou Tao stroked his beard and gave Shen Suan a narrow smile.
